content: I taako, “Asa na7aw, denda eqa. Ta neera odetanaw koyayis” yaagis.
I taara odetiya wode Xoossa Ayyaani ta giddo gelidi, tana ta tohuwan essis; I taw odeysa si7as.
“Asa na7aw, ta nena Isra7eele asaako, ta bolla makallida deriyako kiittayis. Entinne enta mayzati hachi gakanaw ta bolla makallida mela de7oosona.
Enti wozana muumenne yeelli baynayisata gidiya gisho, ta nena entako kiittayis. Taani, Ubbaa Haariya Goday haysada yaagayis.
Ha makallancho asay si7in, si7onna ixin, nabey enta giddon de7eysa enti erana.
Asa na7aw, entawunne enta qaalas yayyofa! Kinchoteynne xunduqey ne yuushon de7ikoka, qassi korneta giddon ne uttikoka yayyofa. Enti makallancho koche gidiya gisho entaw woyko enta qaalas yayyofa.
Enti makallancho koche gidiya gisho enti si7in, si7onna ixin ta qaala entaw oda.
Shin, asa na7aw, ta new odeysa si7a. Ha makallancho asaada neka makallancho gidopa; ne doona dooyada ta new immeysa ma” yaagis.
Ta xeelliya wode, Heko, taako micetida kushe be7as; he kushiyan xaatha maxaafi de7ees.
I ta sinthan he xaatha maxaafa billis; he maxaafas nam7u baggara yeehoy, azzanoynne zelelsi huuphe qofa gididi xaafetis.
